sequence: A queen is first shown triumphantly burning old laws, reclaiming her power with a flame. Then she looks worried with a shield and spears, and an armored man appears as she tries to amass an army needing supplies, steel, rations and funded battalions. A chain diagram shows burning thrones leading to 20 houses alienated and then funding and supply lost, ending with her sad beside the flame: the move was terrible because she burned her own supply chains.
confusing: The flame returns at the end with no explicit link to the supply-chain diagram; the four containers with identical orange dots show no real quantity and read as decoration. The second node of the first chain frame is blank until labeled, and the first two headlines (power back) are triumphant while the passage turns negative abruptly. The shield with spears is ambiguous without sound.
